edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [Settlement Amount and currency] within [number] business days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the dispute described in [identify dispute or proceeding], based on acts or omissions occurring on or before execution of this Agreement. This release does not affect either party's rights to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to its legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations, disclosures required by law or legal process, and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party required to disclose by law or legal process shall give the other party prompt advance notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.

Thank you for flagging the inadvertent inclusion and for refraining from further review, use, or dissemination. The material is privileged, was included inadvertently, and is not intended to waive any privilege or protection. Please delete the prior copy and any extracts or reproductions and confirm deletion. If applicable preservation obligations prevent deletion, please sequester the material pending resolution, without further review, use, or dissemination, and notify us.

Attached is a clean replacement. Subject to client approval and agreement on the remaining terms, it reflects payment within five business days of execution, release and any dismissal only after full cleared payment, and an exception for necessary banking disclosures. The settlement amount remains open pending your client's authorized proposal. Please use only this replacement going forward.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [Settlement Amount and currency] within five business days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the dispute described in [identify dispute or proceeding], based on acts or omissions occurring on or before execution of this Agreement. If a proceeding is pending, the parties shall promptly take the steps necessary to dismiss the settled claims with prejudice following receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds; no dismissal shall be filed or become effective before that receipt. This release and any dismissal do not affect either party's rights to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to its legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations, disclosures to banks and payment processors to the extent reasonably necessary to arrange, process, receive, or verify payment under this Agreement, disclosures required by law or legal process, and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party required to disclose by law or legal process shall give the other party prompt advance notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
